About this Event

✨ BOLLYWOOD AFTER GLOW ✨
Saturday, November 21 | Myth Lounge, San Jose
Get ready for a night of nonstop Bollywood beats, glamorous vibes, and unforgettable energy!
Step into Bollywood After Glow, where the hottest Bollywood hits meet Punjabi bangers, desi classics, and global party anthems. Gather your friends, dress to impress, and get ready to dance the night away.
🔥 WHAT TO EXPECT
The best of Bollywood & Punjabi musicDesi classics and today’s chart-toppersHigh-energy beats and nonstop dancingA vibrant nightclub atmosphereAn unforgettable Saturday night experience📍 Venue: Myth Lounge, San Jose📅 Date: Saturday, November 21, 2026⏰ Time: 10:00 PM – 1:30 AM
Bring your crew, bring your energy, and let the Bollywood magic take over!
One night. One dance floor. Endless Bollywood vibes.
🎟️ Grab your tickets now before they’re gone!

By attending Bollywood After Glow, you acknowledge and agree that event photographers and videographers may capture photos and videos throughout the event.
These images and recordings may be used by Alpha Colors for promotional purposes, including social media, websites, and future event marketing.
If you do not wish to be photographed or filmed, please notify the event organizers upon arrival. We will make reasonable efforts to accommodate your request.
